court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
case_name: Palash S/O Purushottam Darokar And 4 ... vs State Of Mah. Thr. Its Pso Ps Sitabuldi ...

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Palash s/o Purushotam Darokar and others (Applicants)

facts_of_case: Marriage between applicant No.1 and Respondent No.2 dissolved by decree of divorce passed on basis of mutual consent; matrimonial dispute extinguished with settlement reached between parties.

legal_principles.principle: A matrimonial dispute does not have and can never have any public dispute characteristic.
legal_principles.held: We are, therefore, inclined to allow the Application.

legal_principles.principle: A settlement reached between parties amicably and voluntarily is a valid legal principle.
legal_principles.held: Palash S/O Purushottam Darokar And 4 ... vs State Of Mah. Thr. Its Pso Ps Sitabuldi ... on 22 July, 2022
cited_cases: Palash S/O Purushottam Darokar And 4 ... vs State Of Mah. Thr. Its Pso Ps Sitabuldi ... (2022)

outcome.final_order: Application is allowed in terms of prayer clause (i) which reads as under: Quash and set aside the FIR lodged by non-applicant no.2.

use_for_drafting: drafting a petition for divorce under Hindu Marriage Act
advising on mutual consent divorce in Nagpur
